sentences.en: Much of Hollywood's production is going to grind to a halt.

sentences.zh: 编剧们由美国编剧工会代表，这是好莱坞最强大的工会之一。

sentences.en: And basically, they're fighting about one thing with the big Hollywood studios.

sentences.en: Money.
sentences.zh: 钱。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that television production has exploded in the last decade, the WGA, the Writers Guild,
sentences.zh: 尽管过去十年电视制作呈爆炸式增长，但编剧工会表示，

sentences.en: they've said that writers' pay has stagnated, and they've been saying for weeks that this moment is existential.
sentences.zh: 编剧的薪酬一直停滞不前，他们几周来一直在说这个时刻关乎生死存亡。

sentences.en: They say the system is broken, and it really has to do with how this industry has changed dramatically in the last decade.
sentences.zh: 他们说这个体制已经崩溃了，这确实与这个行业在过去十年中发生剧烈变化的方式有关。

sentences.en: And it all has to do with streaming.
sentences.zh: 这一切都与流媒体有关。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We live in a world of streaming now, right?
sentences.zh: 我们现在生活在一个流媒体的世界里，对吧？

sentences.en: There's no more rushing home to watch Seinfeld at 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 再也没有人急着赶回家在晚上8点看《宋飞正传》了。

sentences.en: It's streaming The Handmaid's Tale 10 episodes at a time, so I watch them all like I'm eating a piece of chocolate cake on a Saturday.

sentences.en: But you'd think that that would mean a real golden age for writers.
sentences.zh: 但你可能会认为那将意味着编剧真正的黄金时代。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: In today's busy world, going to the video store is a hassle.

sentences.en: With Netflix.

sentences.en: Return one in this prepaid envelope, and they'll automatically send you another movie from your liSt.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.zh: 但当时他们有一项已经运营了四年的流媒体服务，

sentences.en: and Netflix executives were pretty convinced that watching TV and movies over the internet was going to become a thing.
sentences.zh: 网飞的高管们相当确信通过互联网观看电视和电影将成为一种趋势。

sentences.en: So it was time for them to get into original series.
sentences.zh: 所以是时候涉足原创剧集了。

sentences.zh: 这一切都始于网飞的大型原创剧集《纸牌屋》，该剧于2013年首播。

sentences.en: So it was 10 o'clock, 11 o'clock, midnight, one in the morning.

sentences.en: Suddenly, I just burned through four episodes.

sentences.en: It was such a crazy concept.

sentences.en: So the show was a huge hit.
sentences.zh: 所以这部剧大获成功。

sentences.en: And it also changed everything.
sentences.zh: 这也改变了一切。

sentences.en: It proved that watching a television show over the internet could work.
sentences.zh: 它证明了通过互联网观看电视剧是行得通的。

sentences.en: And it caused a shift in the industry, which fundamentally changed the way that writers work.
sentences.zh: 它引发了行业的变革，从根本上改变了编剧的工作方式。

sentences.en: And it changed the business for the studios, which has led us to this moment.
sentences.zh: 它改变了制片厂的业务，从而把我们带到了这一刻。

sentences.en: So let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: How did streaming change the industry, not just for us as viewers, but also for the people making these shows?
sentences.zh: 流媒体是如何改变这个行业的，不仅对我们这些观众，也对制作这些节目的幕后人员？

sentences.en: So production has really, really changed.
sentences.zh: 所以制作方式确实发生了翻天覆地的变化。

sentences.zh: 回想一下20世纪90年代。

sentences.zh: 如果你是在这样一部剧（网剧）里担任编剧的员工，你会得到很好的照顾。

sentences.en: That was your career.
sentences.zh: 那就是你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: That was your career.
sentences.zh: 那就是你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: But in the streaming world, now that we've got those movie stars who like shorter commitments, we've got seasons that are eight, nine, ten episodes.

sentences.en: So they've said that this is untenable.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说这是不可持续的。

sentences.en: And it's affecting everyone.
sentences.zh: 而且这影响到了每一个人。

sentences.en: It's affecting totally decorated showrunners and writers just getting their foot in the door.
sentences.zh: 它既影响了备受赞誉的剧集运作人，也影响了刚刚踏入行业的新人编剧。

sentences.en: So it sounds like everything is just much less stable for writers.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来对编剧来说一切都变得很不稳定。

sentences.en: Much shorter seasons, just a few months or even a few weeks versus a whole year or several years, which means, by definition, less work and more scrambling.
sentences.zh: 更短的剧季，只有几个月甚至几周，对比一整年或好几年，这意味着，从定义上讲，工作减少了，奔波更多了。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: But the writers think that there could be long-term consequences to this.
sentences.zh: 但编剧们认为这可能会产生长期的后果。

sentences.en: I recently interviewed Mike Schur.
sentences.zh: 我最近采访了迈克·舒尔。

sentences.zh: 他是《公园与游憩》的联合创作者和《善地》的创作者。

sentences.en: Yeah, they say it's bad for their careers, but on top of that, it's bad for the industry at large.

sentences.en: So, John, we've talked about how streaming has changed the way TV shows are made.
sentences.zh: 那么，约翰，我们讨论了流媒体是如何改变电视剧制作方式的。

sentences.en: But what about the underlying business?
sentences.zh: 但底层的商业模式呢？

sentences.en: Has it changed how the people who make these shows, including the writers, make their money?
sentences.zh: 它是否改变了这些节目的创作者（包括编剧）赚钱的方式？

sentences.en: So, it's upended the economics, really, in how both sides make money.
sentences.zh: 所以，它确实彻底颠覆了双方赚钱的经济模式。

sentences.en: So, one of the things that the writers are fighting for in this dispute is better residual pay.
sentences.zh: 因此，编剧们在这场纠纷中争取的事情之一就是更好的重播版税。

sentences.en: That's a type of royalty.
sentences.zh: 那是一种版税收入。

sentences.en: In the old model, with success, a writer would get a lot.
sentences.zh: 在旧模式下，如果作品成功了，编剧能赚很多钱。

sentences.en: So, The Big Bang Theory, that was a show on CBS.
sentences.zh: 比如《生活大爆炸》，那是哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）的一档节目。

sentences.en: If you're flipping through channels and you see it on TBS, it's in syndication.
sentences.zh: 如果你在换台时看到它在TBS电视台播出，那就是在进行辛迪加联合播出。

sentences.en: That's like a rerun.
sentences.zh: 这就像是重播一样。

sentences.en: So, if you wrote an episode of a popular show and it goes into syndication, you could potentially make a pretty decent amount of money off of episodes you wrote.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你为一个热门剧集写过一集剧本，而它被卖去联合播出，你完全可以通过你写过的剧集赚取相当可观的收入。

sentences.en: You'd, like, just get a check in the mail.
sentences.zh: 你就像是会直接收到一张支票。

sentences.en: Or, if the production company, which was Warner Brothers in this case, sells it overseas, and
sentences.zh: 或者，如果制作公司（本案中是华纳兄弟）把它卖到海外，然后

sentences.en: suddenly you're in Ireland watching The Big Bang Theory, you just get a check in the mail.

sentences.en: And this really helped writers.

sentences.en: Maybe you want to create a show.

sentences.zh: 也许你想写一个电影剧本。

sentences.en: They argued that those residual payments would keep you afloat.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这些重播版税能维持你的生计。

sentences.en: It was sort of a critical source of income for the middle-class writer.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是中产阶级编剧的关键收入来源。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Crucial economic lifeline in the before days.
sentences.zh: 这是过去时代的至关重要的经济生命线。

sentences.en: What about now?
sentences.zh: 那现在呢？

sentences.en: So, now they argue that everything has changed.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在他们认为一切都变了。

sentences.en: Because if you are in Netflix or you're in Amazon, there are no distribution arMs.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你在奈飞或亚马逊工作，根本就没有分销部门。

sentences.en: You're not putting shows into syndication.
sentences.zh: 你没有把节目放到联合播出机构去。

sentences.en: You're not selling them overseas.
sentences.zh: 你也没有把它们卖到海外。

sentences.en: They're global streaming services.
sentences.zh: 它们是全球性的流媒体服务。

sentences.en: Now, the Netflix and Amazons pay sort of a fixed residual.

sentences.en: Writers are arguing they're making less money in sort of the afterlife of a show, after it has been on the air.

sentences.en: John, from what you're describing, it really sounds like the studios are in this kind of defensive crouch over money, which is kind of weird because streaming is the way everybody

sentences.en: watches TV now, right?

sentences.en: The cable bundle used to kick off so much money.

sentences.en: I mean, we've been talking about canceling streaming services and how easy it is.

sentences.en: You might remember how difficult it was to cancel.

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Do I remember?

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They would try to negotiate with you.
sentences.zh: 他们会试图和你谈判。

sentences.en: They would convince you out of it.

sentences.en: You would be on the phone for 45 minutes.

sentences.en: Forget it.

sentences.en: But that was okay because the profits didn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 但这没关系，因为利润其实并不重要。

sentences.en: All these companies wanted to do, at least as of two years ago, was just grow their subscriber base.

sentences.en: So, it was okay to lose money.
sentences.zh: 所以亏钱也是可以接受的。

sentences.en: So, kind of like Uber and Lyft in the early days, right?

sentences.en: Just like compete, compete, compete for subscribers, for market share.

sentences.en: In recent months, Netflix has had to change course and cut costs,
sentences.zh: 最近几个月，网飞不得不改变方针并削减成本，

sentences.en: from laying off hundreds of staff to cracking down on password sharing in some regions by charging additional fees.
sentences.zh: 从裁员数百人，到在一些地区通过收取额外费用来打击密码共享。

sentences.en: That's when Wall Street changed its mind about the growth-at-any-cost strategy of these media companies.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，华尔街改变了对这些传媒公司不惜一切代价追求增长的战略的看法。

sentences.en: That's when they said, we need to see these streaming services turn a profit.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，他们说，我们需要看到这些流媒体服务实现盈利。

sentences.en: We cannot see you losing a billion dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 我们不能看着你们每年亏损十亿美元。

sentences.en: And the fallout from that over the last year has been brutal.
sentences.zh: 过去一年由些引发的后果是残酷的。

sentences.en: Disney is looking to find $5.5 billion in cost savings.
sentences.zh: 迪士尼正寻求节约55亿美元的成本。

sentences.en: Disney is in the midst of 7,000 job cuts.
sentences.zh: 迪士尼正在进行7000人的裁员。

sentences.en: CNN starting a new round of layoffs just months after shuttering its CNN Plus streaming service.
sentences.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网在关闭其CNN Plus流媒体服务几个月后，又开始了新一轮裁员。

sentences.en: Warner Brothers Discovery cut thousands of jobs last year and also shelved titles.
sentences.zh: 华纳兄弟探索公司去年裁员数千人，并搁置了多个项目。

sentences.en: Yeah, another disappointing quarter for Paramount.
sentences.zh: 是的，对派拉蒙来说又是令人失望的一个季度。

sentences.en: If we take a look at the numbers here, revenue coming in.
sentences.zh: 如果我们看一下这里的数字，收入进账情况。

sentences.en: And other companies like Paramount or NBCUniversal, they've also adopted these cost-saving measures.
sentences.zh: 派拉蒙或全国广播公司环球等其他公司也采取了这些节约成本的措施。

sentences.en: So again, similar to Uber and Lyft, at some point, investors said profits are important.
sentences.zh: 所以再次说明，类似于优步和利福特，在某个时候，投资者表示利润很重要。

sentences.en: Make them.
sentences.zh: 把利润做出来。

sentences.en: So given that, in this situation, can the companies afford what the writers are asking?
sentences.zh: 那么鉴于此，在这种情况下，这些公司能负担得起编剧们的要求吗？

sentences.en: Well, shortly before the strike was announced, the studios said that they actually did offer,
sentences.zh: 嗯，就在罢工宣布前不久，各大电影公司表示，他们确实提供了，

sentences.en: quote, generous increases in compensation for writers as well as, quote, improvements in residuals.
sentences.zh: 引述一下，“为编剧提供慷慨的薪酬增长”，以及引述，“提高重播收益”。

sentences.en: But the studios also said that there were just too many other outstanding issues on the table.
sentences.zh: 但电影公司也表示，桌面上还有太多其他悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: I talked to one of the negotiators on the writer's side, and he told me the night the strike was announced that philosophically and practically, the two sides are very far apart.
sentences.zh: 我采访了编剧阵营的一名谈判代表，他在宣布罢工的当晚告诉我，在理念和实际操作上，双方的分歧非常巨大。

sentences.en: So, John, all this brings us back to the deadlock, where we still are and may be for some time.
sentences.zh: 所以，约翰，这一切把我们带回了僵局，我们目前仍处于僵局，而且可能会持续一段时间。

sentences.en: What's the immediate effect of it?
sentences.zh: 这会带来什么直接影响？

sentences.en: So, daily shows, shows that are made every day, like late-night shows, they've gone dark.
sentences.zh: 所以，每日秀，那些每天制作的节目，比如深夜秀，都已经停播了。

sentences.en: So, no Stephen Colbert, no Seth Meyers, no Jimmy Kimmel.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有斯蒂芬·科尔伯特，没有赛斯·迈尔斯，没有吉米·坎摩尔。

sentences.en: They are all sitting this out.
sentences.zh: 他们都不干了。

sentences.en: They're all WGA members, and they are—there will be no new shows for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 他们都是美国编剧工会的成员，而且他们——在可预见的未来将不会有新节目。

sentences.en: Saturday Night Live, also off the air, and they might not be able to have their season finale.
sentences.zh: 周六夜现场也停播了，他们可能无法制作本季的季终集。

sentences.en: Soap operas, they will run out of episodes within a few weeks, maybe a month.
sentences.zh: 肥皂剧的剧集将在几周内，也许一个月内播完。

sentences.en: Longer term, it would take a while.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，这需要一段时间。

sentences.en: I mean, there are a lot of shows that are in the can, and there are some shows where all the scripts are done and they can keep filming.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有很多节目已经制作完成并存着，还有一些节目剧本全部写完，他们可以继续拍摄。

sentences.en: However, if it's a really long strike, if a strike lasts several months, viewers could start to notice fewer new TV shows by the end of the year or early next year.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果这是一场非常持久的罢工，如果罢工持续数月，观众可能会开始发现在今年年底或明年初新的电视节目变少了。

sentences.en: And that might mean more unscripted series.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着更多无剧本的系列节目。

sentences.en: In the past, when other strikes happened, there have been several, the industry has adapted in interesting ways.
sentences.zh: 过去，当其他罢工发生时——已经发生过好几次了——行业以有趣的方式进行了调整。

sentences.en: For example, during the 1988 strike, which lasted five months, that's when Fox programmed cops because it needed unscripted programming.
sentences.zh: 例如，在1988年持续了五个月的罢工期间，福克斯公司播放了《缉毒特警》，因为它需要无剧本节目。

sentences.en: Oh, phony.
sentences.zh: 哦，虚假节目。

sentences.en: I didn't realize that.
sentences.zh: 我之前没意识到这一点。

sentences.en: And during the 2007-2008 strike, that's when NBC decided, is there something we can do to shake up The Apprentice?
sentences.zh: 而在2007至2008年的罢工期间，全国广播公司决定，我们能做点什么来重振《学徒》吗？

sentences.en: And that's when NBC executives came up with Donald Trump's The Celebrity Apprentice.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，全国广播公司的高管们想出了唐纳德·特朗普的《名人学徒》。

sentences.en: Funny.
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: Funny.
sentences.zh: 真逗。

sentences.en: Like, necessity is the mother of invention.
sentences.zh: 就像那句话说的，需求是发明之母。

sentences.en: You don't have writers, you do reality TV.
sentences.zh: 你没有编剧，你就做真人秀。

sentences.en: So, in a way, the changes have the ability to shape our culture.
sentences.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，这些变化有能力塑造我们的文化。

sentences.en: Like, in quiet ways we don't always fully notice or understand.
sentences.zh: 就像以我们并不总是完全注意到或理解的安静方式一样。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And the actors and directors, their unions, those negotiations are going to begin soon, and their contracts expire at the end of June.
sentences.zh: 而演员和导演们的工会，他们的谈判很快就要开始了，他们的合同在6月底到期。

sentences.en: So, that could either complicate the writers' strike, that is, those two unions make a deal and kind of undercut the writers' guild,
sentences.zh: 所以，这要么会使编剧罢工变得复杂，也就是说，这两个工会达成协议，从而削弱编剧工会的力量，

sentences.en: or they decide their working conditions have been upended by streaming, and then suddenly we have three unions on strike at once.
sentences.zh: 要么他们认为自己的工作条件已被流媒体颠覆，然后突然之间我们同时有三个工会在罢工。

sentences.en: So, like, a 10-car pileup of strikes, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上就像一场十车相撞的连环罢工。

sentences.en: That would really be, like, a disaster.
sentences.zh: 那真的就像一场灾难。

sentences.en: That would be catastrophic for Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 对好莱坞来说那将是灾难性的。

sentences.en: Okay, but just stepping back here for a second.
sentences.zh: 好的，但我们稍微退一步来看。

sentences.en: Like, what would you say to someone who sees this strike from the outside and is trying to make sense of it?
sentences.zh: 比如，你会对一个从外部看到这场罢工并试图理解它的人说些什么？

sentences.en: Like, listening to this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 就像听这个播客的人。

sentences.en: I mean, we're talking about professional writers in Hollywood, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在谈论好莱坞的专业编剧，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, educated people, basically pretty much fine in the workforce, no?
sentences.zh: 比如受过良好教育的人，在劳动力市场基本上过得挺好，不是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, like, in some sense, world's smallest violin, no?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从某种意义上说，这是在为赋新词强说愁，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, from the writer's perspective, there's a distinction between the big established names, the Shonda Rhimeses, the Ryan Murphys, the multimillionaires,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，从编剧的角度来看，那些大牌知名人士，比如珊达·莱梅斯、瑞恩·墨菲、千万富翁们，

sentences.en: versus the working writer trying to get their foot in the door, trying to craft a career.
sentences.zh: 与那些正努力踏入门槛、试图开创职业生涯的普通编剧之间是有区别的。

sentences.en: And also, a prolonged strike has the potential to affect a lot of people in the industry, not just writers.
sentences.zh: 而且，长期罢工可能会影响行业中的许多人，不仅仅是编剧。

sentences.en: The last time there was a strike, 15 years ago, it damaged the Los Angeles economy by an estimated $2.1 billion.
sentences.zh: 15年前上一次罢工时，它对洛杉矶经济造成了估计21亿美元的损害。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: What was that made up of?
sentences.zh: 这主要是由什么组成的？

sentences.en: So, there are so many small businesses that help keep productions afloat.
sentences.zh: 有那么多小企业帮助维持影视制作的运转。

sentences.en: That includes drivers, costume dry cleaners, caterers, set carpenters, lumber yard workers.
sentences.zh: 这包括司机、服装干洗工、餐饮服务商、布景木匠、木材厂工人。

sentences.en: The whole ecosystem of movies.
sentences.zh: 电影的整个生态系统。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a lot of them will soon be out of work, especially as Hollywood production gradually grinds to a halt.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人很快就会失业，特别是随着好莱坞的影视制作逐渐陷入停顿。

sentences.en: And they've just regained their footing out of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们才刚从大流行中恢复过来。

sentences.en: So, that really increases the stakes of a strike and could potentially lead to some community fissures.
sentences.zh: 所以，这确实增加了罢工的利害关系，并可能导致一些社区裂痕。

sentences.en: So, John, I'm left kind of wondering at the end of our conversation, you know, what this fight over streaming has showed us.
sentences.zh: 所以，约翰，在我们的对话结束时，我禁不住想知道，你知道，这场关于流媒体的争斗向我们展示了什么。

sentences.en: Has it shown us that we, as consumers of all this content, were the winners, but it's a much murkier new world for the studios and the creatives?
sentences.zh: 它是否向我们展示了，我们作为所有这些内容的消费者是赢家，但对于电影公司和创意人员来说，这是一个更加模糊不清的新世界？

sentences.en: And is this the end of the era of amazing television?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着精彩电视时代的终结？

sentences.en: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不一定。

sentences.en: We're not going to see the days of 500 scripted shows anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再看到500部有剧本节目并存的日子了。

sentences.en: But good TV and good movies, they've been around for a long time.
sentences.zh: 但好的电视剧和好的电影，它们已经存在很长时间了。

sentences.en: And if you think of the times when the writers have gone on strike before, many times these occurred at sort of these inflection points because of big technological shifts.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想以往编剧罢工的时期，很多时候这些都发生在由于重大技术变革而产生的转折点上。

sentences.en: In the 1980s, you had the rise of cable TV and the rise of a home video.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，你迎来了有线电视的兴起和家庭录像带的兴起。

sentences.en: In 2007, during that strike, think of how we were consuming content back then.
sentences.zh: 在2007年，在那场罢工期间，想想我们当时是如何消费内容的。

sentences.en: You still bought DVDs, but you were also starting to do it digitally.
sentences.zh: 你仍然买DVD，但你也开始以数字方式获取内容。

sentences.en: You were renting shows.
sentences.zh: 你租借节目。

sentences.en: You were downloading shows off of iTunes, right?
sentences.zh: 你从iTunes上下载节目，对吧？

sentences.en: YouTube at that point was only two years old.
sentences.zh: 当时YouTube诞生才两年。

sentences.en: And now here we are at yet another technological inflection point.
sentences.zh: 现在我们又来到了另一个技术转折点。

sentences.en: But we still have TV.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然有电视。

sentences.en: We still have movies, like really good ones.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然有电影，而且是非常好的电影。

sentences.en: It's been about a decade since the streamers have become Ascendant.
sentences.zh: 自从流媒体崛起以来，大约已经过去十年了。

sentences.en: But we're still in the early days of the streaming wars.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍处于流媒体大战的早期阶段。

sentences.en: So there are going to be inevitable skirmishes.
sentences.zh: 所以会有不可避免的冲突。

sentences.en: This will not be the last one.
sentences.zh: 这不会是最后一次。

sentences.en: But yes, VCRs are gone.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，录像机已经消失了。

sentences.en: Cable's slowly going away.
sentences.zh: 有线电视正在慢慢消失。

sentences.en: But TV persists.
sentences.zh: 但电视依然存在。

sentences.en: TV is not over.
sentences.zh: 电视并没有结束。

sentences.en: It's just going to be different.
sentences.zh: 它只是会变得不同。

sentences.en: John, thank you.
sentences.zh: 约翰，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一种非常具体的情况。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有过敏史，或者对食物敏感？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App 或你常用的播客平台上搜索《The Wirecutter Show》。'

sentences.zh: 我们到时见。
